integrity: The theorem has a direct infinite-step inductive proof and exact one-step sign counterexamples. Finite computational checks are supplementary. Mathematical originality is restricted to the published biomass stencil and its parameter-grid consequence; antecedent cone-preservation theory is classical.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to the printed forward Saulyev sweep with constant nonnegative Monod exponent, nonnegative one-way advection, arbitrary nonnegative input arrays, left Dirichlet values and zero right Neumann input. It does not assert that the motivating article’s constant-initial-data simulations go negative, nor establish convergence or general Saulyev instability.
title: A sharp positivity window for the Monod–Saulyev biomass discretization
